newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH INDUSTRIAL CLIMATE COOLS IN FEBRUARY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH INDUSTRIAL CLIMATE COOLS IN FEBRUARY.

text.p: the manufacturing sector declined in February as demand and
output worsened during the month, but the outlook for March was
better, the Central Statistics Office (GUS) said on Monday.
In its monthly survey GUS said the industrial climate index
fell to 8 points in February from 13 in January with firms in
the private sector better off than public ones.
"Managers worsened evaluations of demand and output as well
as their financial situation, but prognosis for March are more
optimistic than current ones," GUS said.
